name: Chord Chantant
description: Véritable nexus de données vivant, Chord Chantant  harmonise les protocoles du réseau, maîtrise le hacking mélodique, voix principale du Chœur.

subject.archetype: Cyborg Martial Artist / Assault Fighter - Androgyne humanoid combat specialist of the Synthetic Choir, embodying the faction's cyber-ascetic philosophy through seamless fusion of monastic serenity and lethal mechanical precision, completely devoid of facial features with smooth metallic cranial plating

loadout.armor_outfit: Worn monastic robes constructed from thick braided synthetic fibers resembling cable bundles in faded monk brown and patinated steel gray, layered over smooth geometric ceramic plating with oxidized bronze accents; ceremonial hood partially obscuring the perfectly smooth featureless metallic facial plate; chapelet of tiny interconnected hard drive discs and processor chips hanging from the waist, swaying with the violent motion
loadout.arsenal: Twin pilgrim staves crackling with electric golden energy arcs; arms thrust forward with palms facing downward sending concentrated shockwaves; floating holographic golden runes and mantras orbiting dynamically around the warrior's body; harmonic resonance nodes visible along exposed forearms glowing with overloaded energy

attitude.behavior: Explosive forward charge mid-air with aggressive momentum, body violently flipping between combat stances as if phasing between physical states; both hands slammed downward toward shattered crystalline ground with immense force; entire body surrounded by unstable rippling energy distortion; frozen moment of the final devastating attack unleashing targeted shockwave through adjacent positions
attitude.emotion: Martial serenity channeled into lethal berserker intensity; cold cybernetic determination devoid of human emotion; the solemn resignation of a dying warrior expending their final energy in one cataclysmic symphonic assault

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic dramatic_low_key_rim_lighting with holographic_glow emanating from shockwave epicenter, electric_golden_sparks scattered throughout scene, volumetric_mist from shattered crystal dust, rim_light_from_behind_emphasizing_silhouette
color_and_light.mood: Epically devastating yet serene, the violent beauty of a sacrificial final attack, peaceful acceptance of mechanical death transmuted into lethal harmonic destruction

camera.angle: low_angle slightly Dutch tilted to emphasize violent forward momentum, positioned at ground level capturing the moment of impact with both hands driving into crystalline floor

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater transformed into catastrophic battlefield; massive crystal formations erupting from harmonic overload explosion; jagged crystalline shards of all sizes exploding outward in every direction; concentric shockwave rings visibly tearing through enemy positions in rippling distortion; countless crystal fragments raining down from resonating cracked ceiling structures; floating mandala-like crystal pieces held in unstable magnetic suspension; broken ceremonial platforms and tiered seating demolished by sonic violence; ancient stone walls cracked and vibrating
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Air rippling and distorting as entire environment vibrates at catastrophic frequency; golden electric shockwave rings expanding outward from warrior's palms; crystal dust particles suspended in mid-air illuminated by holographic golden light; blue-white electrical discharge from overloading harmonic emitters; chromatic aberration intensifying at impact point; atmospheric haze from shattered crystal particulate matter; gravity distortion effects around floating debris
